optimizedContext.value:
# Coding Conventions

## Rules
- TypeScript: `strict: true`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`; no `@ts-ignore`/`@ts-expect-error` without comment
- ESM only: `"type": "module"`, `NodeNext`; no CommonJS unless documented exception
- Named exports only; no default exports
- Files: `kebab-case.ts`; tests `.spec.ts` in `test/` mirroring `src/` (not co-located); no `index.ts` except package root; layer barrels permitted if >50 internal modules
- No `any`; use `unknown` + type guards; wrap third-party `any` in typed adapters
- Public exports: explicit return types; private may infer
- Errors in `@specd/core`: extend `SpecdError`; no generic `Error` for expected failures; machine-readable `code`; follow `default:_global/error-handling-conventions`
- Private backing fields: underscore prefix (`_name` for `get name()`)
- Lazy loading: `list()`/`search()` return metadata/reference only; full content via explicit `get()`/`artifact()`/`resolve()`; never speculative preload
- Immutability: `readonly` on domain VOs/entities; `as const` for config literals

## Constraints
- strict via tsconfig.base.json
- No default exports; no `any`
- kebab-case.ts source files
- Domain/application errors extend SpecdError
- Public APIs have explicit return types
- Collection methods return metadata only; content via explicit load
